name: Toggl
summary: Toggl is free for up to 3 users, and its Starter and Premium plans cost $9 and $16 per user a month on annual billing. New customers get Toggl 2.0, which replaced Toggl Track for sign-ups. Timesheet approvals and single sign-on start on Premium.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: Toggl 2.0 is the product sold to new customers. Toggl says Toggl Track stays available and supported for existing users, with no announced end date.
Toggl 2.0 lists no built-in invoicing. Hours leave as CSV, XLSX or PDF exports or through the API, and Toggl's QuickBooks Online and Xero integrations are marked as legacy Toggl Track integrations.
Toggl states that it does not take screenshots or record keystrokes, browsing history or location.
EU data hosting is available for Toggl 2.0 and not for Toggl Track.
Toggl's help center lists Toggl Track Premium at $18 per user a month on annual billing, while the current pricing page lists Premium at $16.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 3 users, with personal reports only

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually; $12 on monthly billing. Adds billable rates and team reports

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; $24 on monthly billing. Adds timesheet approvals and single sign-on

hiddenCosts: Time Off Management is an add-on at $2 per user a month.
Capacity Management is an add-on at $5 per user a month on annual billing or $6 monthly.
Premium on monthly billing costs $24 per user, 50% more than the annual price.

contract.cancellation: Fees are non-refundable under the terms, and Toggl may change fees with a month's notice.
contract.dataExport: PDF reports on every plan, CSV and XLSX reports on Starter and above, and the API on every plan.
